title: 1 October 2015: Ringo Starr live at Nob Hill Masonic Auditorium, San Francisco
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band kicked off the autumn leg of their 2015 tour with a performance at the Nob Hill Masonic Auditorium in San Francisco, California, USA, on 1 October 2015.

Thank you San Francisco for a great night peace and love from Ringo and the All-Stars ??????????? pic.twitter.com/EE0thjxhsN

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 2, 2015

It was the 18th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

Starr returned to the Masonic Auditorium on 11 June 2023.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
